title: Mitch McConnell Wells Fargo Stock Purchase: $15K–$50K (Sep 2026)
content:

What's been disclosed

  • The purchase: A purchase of Wells Fargo stock worth $15,001–$50,000 on September 1, disclosed on September 21.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Wells Fargo about 7.6% lower on October 2 than the price on the purchase date.
  • Filing: One trade line in the data we pulled for this member; no repeated rows.

Quick FAQ

How long after the purchase was it disclosed?
20 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why is the amount a range?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
